contentText:
Ella Langley’s “Be Her” joins the top 10 of the Hot 100, but can she hold on to the No. 1 spot for a sixth week?

Tetris Kelly: This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated April 18. “Folded” stays locked at 10. “Stateside” slips to nine. Ella Langley’s “Be Her” joins the top 10. “Golden” stays at seven. “So Easy” holds at No. 6. BTS’ “Swim” down to five. “Ordinary” is up to No. 4, as is “I Just Might” to three and “Man I Need” to No. 2. So grabbing six weeks at No. 1 is Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas.”
